name: Blood Rush
description: Quinary ability: on a 15-second cooldown, gain 20 blood charge and stay active for 10 seconds. While active the meter rises by 1% per second; while inactive it drains by 0.25% per second. Filling the meter to 100 consumes it and triggers 25 seconds of blindness, darkness, strength, 50% lifesteal and non-lethal health degeneration.
